commands.not_rerun: run, substituted_dispatched and cancel were last run on the earlier review tree (dispatch blake3 ee77a645…): run 0/0/2/1/0, substituted-dispatched retained dispatched:true on dispatch and recover, cancel 0. The re-review asked for the five scenarios below.

lattice_stdout.recover-moved: the retained execution observation (result.disposition failed), not a closure

moved-root.observed: Kiln's acknowledgement was lost while Lattice ran the first launch under root A (SIGKILL of kiln-lattice-dispatch after the worker reached the endpoint, the lost-during-run mechanism). The profile then named root B. Kiln recovered with the bound root A, reconciled the retained execution with no second endpoint request, and never created root B; the replay reconciled the same execution.

lost-before-start.observed: With the binding and bound root retained before the transport intent, recovery runs in the bound root and its exact closure record is settled as no execution; the replay is refused before transport.

lost-during-run.observed: SIGKILL of the controller; bound recovery reconciles the retained result without re-execution.

lattice_stdout.stale-fence-replay: status not_started_closed_by_recovery from recover in the bound root

refusals.observed: stale_fence is not settled; the dispatch keeps the attempt with its transport intent. The replay recovers with the bound program and root; Lattice finds no intent there and exclusively closes the attempt, and Kiln records that closure as no execution. kiln-crossed-fence (plan fence + 1) is refused at claim authorization and kiln-unplanned before plan reservation, both before any durable step.

crossed.observed: A run refusal of a reason the reviewer verified settles; the replay is refused by Kiln before transport.

changed: refusals: stale_fence stays retained on dispatch; the bound recovery then closes the attempt and Kiln settles it as no execution (before: retained with an unreconciled intent)
lost-before-start: the bound recovery's closure is no execution (before: reconciled as an execution); the replay is refused
worker requests carry dispatch_plan; observations echo it
comparison_with_lattice_evidence.unchanged: lost-during-run exits and endpoint request count

non_claims: No model was called; every worker reached only the local HTTP 400 endpoint, so no candidate was produced
The credential pass-through was exercised by unit tests and a real child process, not by this composed run; every broker here declares credential:null
The bound state root is assumed durable; losing or replacing it in place voids the no-start evidence of a closure recovered from it
A crash between the owner-grant gate and the transport intent (a window that predates this change) is not exercised and remains open
The Lattice binary is a local release build of the published commit added to the Nix store, not a Nix-built package
The live scenario, Kiln #49 deployment and Kiln #46 independent acceptance remain separate
